test_AwsCloud_get_cloudwatch_logs: test the AwsCloud class to fetch paginated CloudWatch logs from a given log group and stream
test_AwsCloud_verify_s3_bucket: test the AwsCloud class to verify an S3 bucket exists using head_bucket
test_AwsCloud_get_glue_crawler_config: test the AwsCloud class to fetch AWS Glue crawler configuration by crawler name
test_AwsCloud_get_athena_database_config: test the AwsCloud class to fetch Athena database config for a given catalog and database
test_AwsCloud_get_kinesis_firehose_strea: test the AwsCloud class to describe a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream and its config
